question: After plunging -13.40% to $66.76 on November 20, 2026, does any technical support or 4H bounce setup remain, or has DOCN entered an accelerating Stage 4 breakdown in a Downtrend market?

epigraph.quote: When a Stage 4 stock slices through your hard stop on expanding volume inside a ten-distribution-day market downtrend, hoping for a bounce is no longer a strategy.
epigraph.author: Stan Weinstein's Stage Framework

web_blocks.title: Stage 4 Acceleration: Breaching $78.00 and Pivot S1 ($67.44)

web_blocks.html: Stage Tag Alignment: Both the quantitative market-facts ledger (Stage 4 (Markdown)) and the structural Weinstein evaluation (STAGE_4, AVOID_STAGE4_OR_BROKEN, CAP_REJECTED) now agree completely as of November 20, 2026 [23][24]. There is no divergence between short-term and structural signals: the trend is decisively broken.

On November 20, 2026, DOCN plunged -13.40% from $77.09 to $66.76 on 5.47 million shares (1.82x 10-day relative volume; 1.40x 20-day average) [23][25]. That drop capped a -22.66% weekly loss (Finviz; -26.26% TradingView) and sliced straight through our prior $78.00 equity hard stop, the $80.00 LEAPS floor, and classic pivot S1 ($67.44) [23][25].

Price now sits -22.02% below its 20-day SMA ($85.61), -38.80% below its falling 50-day SMA ($109.09), -41.11% below its 200-day SMA ($113.37), and -46.98% below its 30-week SMA ($125.92) [23][25]. Seven distribution days hit the stock over the past 25 sessions. Meanwhile, the broader S&P 500 entered a full Downtrend regime with 10 distribution days, 38.8% breadth above the 50-DMA, and just 1 of 11 sectors above their 20-DMA [35].

Every timeframe from 4-hour to weekly confirms active distribution [23][24]. Weekly RSI(14) dropped to 35.17 and Daily RSI(14) fell to 31.04, while 4-hour RSI(14) sank to 29.37 with intraday_4h_turn: false [23]. Price trades far below its 4H EMA20 ($79.48) and 4H SMA50 ($88.01), erasing the brief mid-November bounce setup [23][24].

Notice one critical anomaly in the automated scanner ledger above: the mechanical support_buy_zone ($94.49–$110.73) and scanner stop ($104.62) now sit above the $66.76 close because the stock collapsed past those moving averages faster than the trailing band updated [23]. Those levels now represent heavy overhead supply, not buy support. Below $66.76, the 20-day swing low is $65.55, followed by thin air down to pivot S2 ($45.23) and the 52-week low ($42.01–$42.77) [23][25].

web_blocks.title: Options Surface & HOLD vs. EXIT Audit on June 2027 $150 LEAPS

web_blocks.html: Our options snapshot confirms NO_OPTIONS_EDGE for new call trades because DOCN sits below both its 50-day and 200-day/30-week structural floors and lacks COMPOUNDER_PASS quality [34]. For our existing portfolio position of 4x DOCN 2027-06-17 $150 Call LEAPS (DOCN270617C00150000, 206 DTE, $3,720.00 MV), the options engine issues a mandatory CLOSE signal because $66.76 breached the $80.00 invalidation floor [34].

With the $150 strike now +124.7% out-of-the-money from $66.76, holding deep OTM LEAPS through a Stage 4 downtrend risks near-total theta decay if DOCN bases sideways in 2027 [34]. Meanwhile, 10.67 million shares remain short (10.99% of float, 3.55 days to cover) with 64.45% Bollinger Band width [23][25]. While oversold RSI (31.04) can trigger brief dead-cat bounces toward $75–$80, institutional flow remains firmly net-distributive [23].

web_blocks.title: What a Real Stage 1 Base and Stage 2 Reset Would Require

web_blocks.html: A broken Stage 4 chart cannot heal in days. First, selling must exhaust itself and carve out a multi-month horizontal floor—holding above either the $65.55 swing low or the deeper $42.01–$45.23 52-week-low shelf [23][25]. Second, the falling 30-week SMA ($125.92) and 50-day SMA ($109.09) must flatten and converge toward price [23].

Third, institutional buyers must step in on expanding weekly volume to push DOCN back above its 30-week average alongside positive relative strength versus the S&P 500 [23][35]. Until all three conditions appear alongside a healthier market breadth regime, CAP_REJECTED stays locked in place.

book_paragraphs: Chapters 1 through 7 established why DigitalOcean's business transition carries heavy lease and dilution costs and why $66.76 offers zero valuation margin of safety. Chapter 8 examines the tape itself as of November 20, 2026—and here, the verdict is even more unforgiving. Between November 13 and November 20, DigitalOcean collapsed another 22.66% on the week, plunging 13.40% on Friday alone to close at $66.76 on 5.47 million shares (1.82x relative volume).

Crucially, there is no longer any disagreement between automated screeners and structural chart work. Both the quantitative market-facts ledger and our Weinstein evaluation classify DOCN as Stage 4 Markdown. Price now sits 46.98% below its 30-week moving average at $125.92, 41.11% below its 200-day average at $113.37, 38.80% below its falling 50-day average at $109.09, and 22.02% below its 20-day average at $85.61.

Most importantly for risk management, Friday's collapse sliced straight through both our prior $80.00 LEAPS invalidation floor and our $78.00 common-equity hard stop, closing below classic Pivot S1 at $67.44. In a market environment that has deteriorated from a Correction into a full ten-distribution-day Downtrend with only 38.8% of stocks above their 50-day average, catching a falling Stage 4 knife is how tactical losses become permanent capital impairment.

Examining technical trend and derivatives positioning reinforces our quantitative caution without leaving any room for discretionary bottom-fishing. DigitalOcean closed at $66.76 in Stage 4 with a CAP_REJECTED timing posture after breaking every major weekly moving average during the November market Downtrend, while volatility expanded alongside Access Industries share overhang and the November 19 CFO Form 144 proposed sale notice of 75,000 shares. Both direct stock exposure and leveraged out-of-the-money call options lack positive mathematical expectancy here. Waiting on the sidelines with 100% USD cash avoids fighting downward institutional distribution and high-beta neocloud compression while preserving capital for clean Stage 2 setups once breadth heals.

book_subsections.title: Loss of the 4-Hour Bounce and Moving-Average Gravity
paragraphs: One week ago, on November 13, a patient trader could point to a developing 4-hour turn—4H RSI had lifted to 48.04 above the 4H EMA20 at $86.01—as justification for staging limit exits into a bounce toward $98.00 and $112.90, provided a strict $78.00 hard stop was honored. That tactical window has now slammed shut. By November 20, 4H RSI sank to 29.37 with the 4H turn flag flipped to false, leaving price stranded well beneath the 4H EMA20 ($79.48) and 4H SMA50 ($88.01).

Meanwhile, volatility has widened dramatically. Daily ATR(14) sits at $8.93—more than 13% of the stock's price—and Bollinger Band width stands at 64.45%. Note also an automated scanner quirk: because price dropped faster than trailing averages recalculated, the scanner's mechanical support band ($94.49–$110.73) now floats far overhead as trapped supply. Below the $65.55 twenty-day swing low, the next meaningful technical shelf sits down at Pivot S2 ($45.23) and the 52-week low ($42.01–$42.77).

book_subsections.title: Options Surface Audit: Closing the June 2027 $150 LEAPS
paragraphs: The options book reinforces the urgency of exiting equity and options risk together. Our options snapshot records NO_OPTIONS_EDGE for new call structures on DOCN because price trades below both the 50-day and 200-day/30-week structural floors while business quality sits at CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rather than COMPOUNDER_PASS.

For our existing four contracts of the June 17, 2027 $150 Call LEAPS (DOCN270617C00150000, 206 days to expiration, $3,720.00 market value), the options audit issues an explicit CLOSE instruction after $66.76 breached the $80.00 invalidation level. With the $150 strike now 125% above spot, any prolonged sideways Stage 1 basing phase through mid-2027 will steadily bleed the remaining $3,720 of time value to zero.

Comparing HOLD versus EXIT makes the math unmistakable. Holding the four contracts requires DOCN to rally +124.7% from $66.76 to $150.00 inside 206 days against a falling 30-week average ($125.92), a $1.0 billion ATM overhang, and a 10-distribution-day market Downtrend—exposing $3,720.00 (4.95% of NAV) to total theta wipeout. Exiting via an immediate CLOSE salvages $3,720.00 in cash, cuts combined DOCN risk from 13.02% to 0% of NAV, and lifts portfolio cash to $12,318.49 (16.40% of NAV).

book_subsections.title: The Long Road Back to Stage 2
paragraphs: Could short interest of 10.67 million shares (10.99% of float, 3.55 days to cover) ignite a sharp oversold bounce from daily RSI 31.04? Certainly—bear-market rallies are notoriously violent. But a one-week dead-cat bounce inside Stage 4 is noise, not accumulation. Re-earning Stage 2 status requires months of horizontal stabilization, flattening of the 30-week moving average, expanding up-volume relative to down-volume, and a broader S&P 500 regime shift out of Downtrend.
